KimBiseo GH settings
This reads the screen through accessibility and taps for you. It is off by default. When you turn it on, enable \'KimBiseo GH screen reading\' in Android accessibility settings.
Read the screen and tap for me
Turning it on shows the consent once, then opens Android accessibility settings. Enable \'KimBiseo GH screen reading\' there. Turning it off stops all screen reading.
Open Android accessibility settings
View consent
Brain (OpenAI-compatible address)
Sends the screen text and goal, and receives the next place to tap. To use the PC KimBiseo brain, enter that brain\'s OpenAI-compatible address.
PC address %1$s — e.g. http://%1$s:8880/v1 (the PC local brain listens on 127.0.0.1 only, so the phone may not reach it)
Model name (e.g. gemma-4-E4B-it · blank = local)
API key (leave blank if none)
Save
Saved.

The small on-phone AI (2B) is not supported as the action brain. Enter the PC brain address. If the local brain listens only on 127.0.0.1, start it on the PC with --host 0.0.0.0 so the phone can reach it.
Target apps
It works only in Coupang, Coupang Eats, Baemin, Chrome and Naver. In other apps it neither reads nor taps the screen.
Safety (enforced by code)
Buttons with Pay · Checkout · Place order · order now · buy now · confirm order are blocked before tapping. It never types into password or card-number fields. Delivery apps stop at \'add to cart\'.
On-phone solo mode (2B) is not supported — enter a PC brain address.
